fusions.name: Stoop From the Gyre
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Dives on a target up to 8 tiles away and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Cutting Crosswind
fusions.desc: Sweeps a gust across a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 12 damage and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slipstream
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Coasting on Thermals
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 45 seconds.
